**Landing: Item tool reads a dotted path, refuses read-only verbs, builds a page's own class**

- `item({path, read:"a.b.c"})` answers a path with no write; refuses when combined with `delta`; caps near 4 KB.
- A delta keyed by `get`/`find`/`toJSON`/`walk`/`root`/`contains`/`member`/`locate` is refused before any write — fixes the exact bug (`{"get":"content"}` on `/live/page.jsonl` silently doing nothing).
- `page.jsonl`'s line-1 `"class"` (relative `"./LivePage.js"` or site-absolute `"/live/LivePage.js"`) now resolves to the real subclass instead of always falling back to plain `Page`.
- New test `Servex/agents/item-read.test.mjs` (27 checks); 5 pre-existing related test files re-verified unchanged (118/40/23/6/13 checks).
- Commit `faf01c784` on `compliance/dev`, three fenced files only.
- **Needs a Servex restart** to take effect — not done, per the brief (a restart would drop the owner's voice call).

**Summary:** The stale ✦ button was `ext/drawer/menu.js`'s `.drawer-menu` — a legitimate, live button every page gets. On the Page Load Error screen (`core/App/App.js:82`), there's no routed page, so no `.sidebar` ever appears to trigger drawer.css's mobile rule that normally steps that fixed button aside for the page's own sidebar toggle. Result: at mobile widths the error screen showed it duplicated alongside the Sheet's own bottom-rail ✦.

Fix (branch `worktree/error-button`, commit `5c3fc83623fe`): `App.error()` now marks `.app` with `app-error`; `drawer.css` hides `.drawer-menu` for that class too, same as `.sidebar`. Nothing was removed — the button is still used everywhere else.

Verified with before/after screenshots (`shots/before-390.png`, `shots/after-390.png`) at `/live/no-such-page-xyz/` and `/framework/no-such/`, desktop unaffected, and `node Server/smoke.mjs` clean (no FAIL).
